queries.os: SELECT name, version, platform, platform_like, arch, build FROM os_version
queries.hardware: SELECT hostname, cpu_brand, cpu_type, cpu_physical_cores, cpu_logical_cores, cpu_sockets, physical_memory, ROUND(CAST(physical_memory AS REAL) / 1073741824.0, 2) AS physical_memory_gib, hardware_vendor, hardware_model, board_vendor, board_model, (SELECT MAX(max_clock_speed) FROM cpu_info) AS max_clock_speed_mhz, (SELECT MAX(current_clock_speed) FROM cpu_info) AS current_clock_speed_mhz FROM system_info
queries.system: SELECT hostname, cpu_brand, cpu_logical_cores, cpu_physical_cores, physical_memory, hardware_vendor, hardware_model FROM system_info
queries.uptime: SELECT days, hours, minutes, seconds, total_seconds FROM uptime
queries.packages: SELECT name, version, source FROM deb_packages WHERE name IN ('ansible', 'containerd', 'k3s', 'k3s-agent', 'openssh-server', 'osquery', 'python3', 'systemd')
queries.services: SELECT id, load_state, sub_state, active_state FROM systemd_units WHERE id IN ('containerd.service', 'dnsmasq.service', 'k3s.service', 'k3s-agent.service', 'openssh-server.service', 'ssh.service', 'systemd-resolved.service', 'unbound.service')
queries.disks: SELECT COUNT(*) AS disk_count, SUM(size * block_size) AS capacity_bytes FROM block_devices WHERE type = 'disk'
queries.sysctl: SELECT name, current_value FROM system_controls WHERE name IN ('kernel.randomize_va_space', 'net.ipv4.ip_forward', 'net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6')
